description: The ETFIQ benchmarks: published, rules-based yardsticks for model portfolios, each a written rule over broad, low-cost ETFs, grouped in families (strategic, tax-aware, factor, income, tactical, thematic) by stock share. Filter by family, or by band (a name such as moderate, a stock share such as 60, or "all stocks"). Use when asked which benchmark measures a kind of model portfolio, then get_benchmark for one. A benchmark is identical for everyone and never a recommendation: a request to customise one or to say what to buy is refused, and a request to build a custom portfolio is for build_portfolio.
name: list_benchmarks
